settings.scrape.info:
Ye NREGA website (VB-G-RAM G) se aapke Panchayat aur Village ke naam app me add karta hai.

Sirf 3 steps:
1️⃣  Browser launch karein
2️⃣  PO/GP login se login karein
3️⃣  'Add Panchayat & Village' par click karein

Bot saare Panchayats aur unke Villages automatically sync kar dega.
